Name: Harvest With Scythe
Author: ThatNorthernMonkey
Description:
[b]This mod is not currently maintained. [url=https://mods.smapi.io/#Harvest_With_Scythe]See mods.smapi.io for alternative mods[/url].[/b]





--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




A little quality of life mod that changes the behaviour of all flowers and crops (including crops on a trellis, and those that regrow) to be harvestable with the Scythe. Much quicker!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eiPvTYM.gif[/img]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
